'''Summon''' is an area in the lobby where players can obtain powerful '''Characters''' to aid them in the completion of Levels. It is located to the left of the '''Leaderboard''' area. 

== Information ==
Each summon is equivalent to 2% Pity. Accumulating 100% Pity will grant you a guaranteed '''Legendary'''. If you were to pull a Legendary character before accumulating 100% Pity, whatever Pity you had before will be reset back to 0%. Each summon costs 50 Gems. 

Every hour, the '''Banner''' will be refreshed, granting different Characters from the previous Banner. This is completely randomized and '''DO NOT''' affect the appearance rate of each Character. 

== Rates ==
Every single '''Character''' has the same rates according to their Rarity. Below are the rates for each Rarity:

* '''Rare''' = 27.3%
* '''Epic''' = 16%
* '''Legendary''' = 2%
* '''Mythic''' = 0.25%

Mythics are known to be very rare! When somebody summons one in '''ANY''' server, it is announced in the Roblox chat globally.
